[ 07 - WHO WE ARE ]

YOUNG, SERIOUS, FROM SOFIA.

Webserotonin is a fast-growing digital agency based in Sofia, Bulgaria. We build landing pages, websites, eCommerce stores, web applications, plugins and SEO programs. We're young, creative, and seriously committed to the craft. We love getting our hands on exciting projects — and we believe a website can, in fact, make you happy.
